turns.prompt: search_records('Foo Bar ') returns nothing even though there is a record tagged foo-bar. Fix the search.
turns.response: Perfect. The fix is complete. The issue was that `normalize_key` didn't strip whitespace before converting the string, so "Foo Bar " would become "foo-bar-" instead of matching the tag "foo-bar". Adding `.strip()` ensures leading and trailing whitespace is removed before processing.

+    return str(value).strip().lower().replace(" ", "-")
